generationInputs.prompt: An editorial and asymmetric infographic slide template inspired by the 1923 Bauhaus exhibition and constructivism art movement. The canvas is a solid stark white background. The composition is divided by thick, solid black structural lines (3px thickness) intersecting at perfect 90-degree angles. On the left side, a massive, heavy geometric sans-serif title in bold black all-caps typography. A large, perfectly flat vibrant signal orange circle is placed asymmetrically in the background, partially behind a block of text. The layout features extreme hierarchy with small caption numbers in a raw typewriter Courier font. High contrast, clean, minimalist industrial poster design, no gradients, no shadows, 2D flat design, 16:9 aspect ratio.
